name: Notion
subtitle: All-in-One Workspace
description: Notion is a powerful workspace that combines notes, tasks, databases, and collaboration in one flexible platform. Whether you're managing projects, organizing personal goals, or building a knowledge base, Notion adapts to your workflow with customizable templates, markdown support, and real-time team collaboration. Sync across all devices and integrate with tools like Slack, Google Drive, and Trello.

reviews.comment: Replaced Evernote, Trello, and my to-do list app—game changer!

name: Todoist
subtitle: Smart Task Manager
description: Todoist helps you organize tasks with natural language input, priority levels, and productivity tracking. Set recurring deadlines, share projects with teams, and visualize progress with Kanban boards. Integrates with Gmail, Calendar, and Alexa for seamless workflow automation. Premium features include reminders, labels, and AI-powered task suggestions.

reviews.comment: The only to-do app that finally stuck with me.

name: Toggl Track
subtitle: Time Management Simplified
description: Toggl Track offers effortless time tracking with one-click timers, detailed reports, and insights into productivity patterns. Ideal for freelancers and teams, it helps identify time drains and optimize workflows. Export data to CSV, integrate with 100+ tools, and set billable rates for clients. Offline tracking ensures no time is lost even without internet.

name: Forest
subtitle: Stay Focused, Be Present
description: Forest combats phone addiction by gamifying focus: plant a virtual tree that grows while you work. If you leave the app, the tree dies. Earn coins to plant real trees worldwide (partnered with Trees for the Future). Includes white noise, customizable focus sessions, and detailed focus history. Perfect for students and remote workers.

name: Evernote
subtitle: Remember Everything
description: Evernote is a digital notebook for capturing ideas, scanned documents, and web clippings. Organize notes with tags, notebooks, and powerful search (even in PDFs and images). Sync across devices, annotate PDFs, and use templates for meeting notes or habit tracking. Premium adds OCR, offline access, and larger uploads.

reviews.comment: My second brain for a decade.

name: Focus@Will
subtitle: Science-Backed Focus Music
description: Focus@Will uses neuroscience-based music to boost concentration by up to 400%. Choose from channels like cinematic, ambient, or alpha waves tailored to your brain type. Tracks adapt dynamically to maintain focus without distraction. Includes productivity timer, focus analytics, and offline listening.

reviews.comment: The ONLY music that doesn’t distract me.

name: TickTick
subtitle: To-Do List & Calendar
description: TickTick merges tasks, reminders, and calendars into one sleek interface. Features include Eisenhower Matrix prioritization, habit tracking, Pomodoro timer, and shared lists. Smart date parsing (e.g., 'every Mon at 9am') and widgets make planning effortless. Syncs with Google Calendar and Siri.

reviews.comment: Finally, a to-do app that handles my chaotic schedule.

name: Craft
subtitle: Beautiful Document Editor
description: Craft blends documents, notes, and wikis with elegant formatting, nested pages, and real-time collaboration. Export to PDF/HTML, publish shareable links, and use @mentions for teamwork. Unique features: cards for organizing ideas, backlinks for knowledge management, and iPad Pencil support for handwritten notes.

reviews.comment: Like Notion, but gorgeous and faster.

name: Freedom
subtitle: Block Distractions
description: Freedom blocks distracting websites and apps across all devices. Schedule focused sessions, block social media/news sites, and even lock down your entire internet. Sync blocks with teammates for group accountability. Works on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android with a single subscription.

reviews.comment: Broke my Twitter addiction in a week.

name: Obsidian
subtitle: Your Second Brain
description: Obsidian is a Markdown-based knowledge base that links notes like a personal Wikipedia. Local storage ensures privacy, while plugins add calendars, Kanban boards, and AI assistance. Ideal for researchers, writers, and developers building a Zettelkasten or digital garden. Sync via paid add-on.

reviews.comment: Where all my ideas finally connect.

name: Spark
subtitle: Smart Email Client
description: Spark revolutionizes email with AI-powered sorting, snooze, and send-later features. Team inboxes, email templates, and integrations with Slack/Google Drive streamline collaboration. Smart Notifications only alert you to important emails. Available on all platforms with E2E encryption.

reviews.comment: Cut my email time in half.

name: Things 3
subtitle: Elegant Task Manager
description: Things 3 combines simplicity with powerful task management. Drag-and-drop projects, headings, and deadlines into a beautiful interface. Features include reminders, calendar integration, and quick-entry keyboard shortcuts. Apple Design Award winner with flawless sync across Apple devices.

reviews.comment: Worth every penny—the perfect to-do app.

name: Raycast
subtitle: Supercharge Your Mac
description: Raycast replaces Spotlight with a lightning-fast launcher for apps, files, and custom scripts. Create AI-powered workflows, control music, manage GitHub issues, and more. Extensions support 1000+ tools. Free for individuals, with team features for businesses.

reviews.comment: I can’t use a Mac without this now.

name: Bear
subtitle: Notes with Style
description: Bear is a minimalist Markdown notes app with focus mode, tags, and export to PDF/DOCX. Themes and typography make writing pleasurable. Pro version adds encryption, cross-note links, and backups. Apple-only (iOS + Mac).

name: Cron
subtitle: Next-Gen Calendar
description: Cron is a sleek calendar app with keyboard shortcuts, shared calendars, and meeting scheduling links. Integrates with Google Calendar and Zoom. Unique features: command palette, day/week/month views, and email-based event creation.

reviews.comment: Finally, a calendar app that doesn’t suck.

name: Superhuman
subtitle: The Fastest Email Ever
description: Superhuman is an elite email client for power users, with AI triage, split-second search, and shortcuts for everything. Undo send, scheduled emails, and read statuses streamline workflow. Invite-only with a steep learning curve but unmatched speed.
